card.name: Group nouns before a describing phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a plural or collective noun phrase about people or groups (leaders, citizenry, soldiers, commissions, states) in general web prose, right where a modifying phrase like 'fired with', 'committed to' or 'enforced by' is likely to follow.

modes.label: Groups of people
modes.description: Noun for a group of people or an institution, about to be followed by a participle phrase describing it.
modes.example: intellectual and spiritual<< leaders>> fired with enthusiasm and endowed with ability.

modes.label: Work, projects or bodies
modes.description: Abstract or collective noun such as work, resistance, projects or commissions that is then described by a trailing phrase.
modes.example: several research<< projects>>, each lasting a reasonable length of time

card.writes: It promotes participle-like words such as acting, working, backed and unsupported, which fit a describing phrase after the noun.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a noun for a group of people or bodies, when a phrase describing them is about to follow.
